notablePrerequisites:
It is your upkeep step.
Mairsil does not have an Aura attached to it.
description:
During your upkeep step, activate Mairsil using Hakim's first ability by paying {U}{U}, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Mairsil.
Activate Mairsil using Lion's Eye Diamond's ability by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U}.
When Mairisil dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Mairisil from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
